<!--
  audio 引擎配置（设备独有，随机型 vendor 镜像下发）。

  原 AOSP 布局把引擎配置拆成 4 个文件，靠 xi:include 串联；本文件是它们的合并版：
  去掉 include，把三棵子树（ProductStrategies / volumeGroups / 默认音量曲线）直接内联。
  HAL 是唯一解析方，audioserver 经 AIDL 取 HAL 的解析结果；换机型只替换本文件。

  消费方：
    - audio HAL（engine/vendor 线，ConfigImpl.cpp 的 kDefaultXmlPath）
      /vendor/etc/audio_config.xml
    - audioserver：不直接读本文件。AudioFlinger 经 IConfig.getEngineConfig
      （AIDL）向 HAL 取引擎配置，HAL 解析本文件后回传；只有 getAudioPolicyConfig
      整体失败时 audioserver 才回退读 XML（那时音频已不可用）。

  展开后的形态），AOSP deserializeCollection 与 HAL collectGroups 都按子树名遍历，

-->

           max_current_ua="0" max_voltage_uv="0"/>

<!-- CDH: 在 lineage 基座基础上新增 "Remote Submix In" 设备，供 scrcpy/REMOTE_SUBMIX

        <item>Telephony Tx</item>
        <item>Telephony Rx</item>
        <item>FM Tuner</item>
        <item>Remote Submix In</item>
    </attachedDevices>
    <defaultOutputDevice>Speaker</defaultOutputDevice>
    <mixPorts>
        <mixPort name="primary output" role="source" flags="AUDIO_OUTPUT_FLAG_PRIMARY">
            <profile name="" format="AUDIO_FORMAT_PCM_16_BIT"
                     samplingRates="8000 11025 16000 32000 44100 48000"
                     channelMasks="AUDIO_CHANNEL_OUT_MONO AUDIO_CHANNEL_OUT_STEREO"/>
        </mixPort>
        <mixPort name="primary input" role="sink">
            <profile name="" format="AUDIO_FORMAT_PCM_16_BIT"
                     samplingRates="8000 11025 16000 32000 44100 48000"
                     channelMasks="AUDIO_CHANNEL_IN_MONO AUDIO_CHANNEL_IN_STEREO"/>
        </mixPort>

        <mixPort name="telephony_tx" role="source">
            <profile name="" format="AUDIO_FORMAT_PCM_16_BIT"
                     samplingRates="8000 11025 16000 32000 44100 48000"
                     channelMasks="AUDIO_CHANNEL_OUT_MONO AUDIO_CHANNEL_OUT_STEREO"/>
        </mixPort>
        <mixPort name="telephony_rx" role="sink">
            <profile name="" format="AUDIO_FORMAT_PCM_16_BIT"
                     samplingRates="8000 11025 16000 32000 44100 48000"
                     channelMasks="AUDIO_CHANNEL_IN_MONO AUDIO_CHANNEL_IN_STEREO"/>
        </mixPort>

        <mixPort name="fm_tuner" role="sink">
            <profile name="" format="AUDIO_FORMAT_PCM_16_BIT"
                     samplingRates="8000 11025 16000 32000 44100 48000"
                     channelMasks="AUDIO_CHANNEL_IN_MONO AUDIO_CHANNEL_IN_STEREO"/>
        </mixPort>
   </mixPorts>
   <devicePorts>
        <devicePort tagName="Speaker" type="AUDIO_DEVICE_OUT_SPEAKER" role="sink">
        </devicePort>
        <devicePort tagName="Telephony Tx" type="AUDIO_DEVICE_OUT_TELEPHONY_TX" role="sink">
        </devicePort>

        <devicePort tagName="Built-In Mic" type="AUDIO_DEVICE_IN_BUILTIN_MIC" role="source">
        </devicePort>
        <devicePort tagName="Telephony Rx" type="AUDIO_DEVICE_IN_TELEPHONY_RX" role="source">
        </devicePort>

        <devicePort tagName="FM Tuner" type="AUDIO_DEVICE_IN_FM_TUNER" role="source">

        <route type="mix" sink="Telephony Tx"

             scan-profile="/sys/module/mac80211_hwsim/parameters/scan_profile"

             reconnect-delay-ms="1000"
             read-timeout-ms="30000"
             protocol-version="1"/>

;; 1. Widevine AIDL HAL（com.google.android.widevine APEX）hal_drm_widevine 域与过渡规则；
;; 2. crash_dump / surfaceflinger 宽松模式（对齐 MTK Android 15 22.2 基线）；
;; 3. cameraserver / system_server / audioserver 对 MTK 虚拟/缺省服务的查询放行与 FRP misc 块设备授权。

;; ---- Widevine 类型与属性 ----
(type hal_drm_widevine)
(roletype object_r hal_drm_widevine)
(type hal_drm_widevine_exec)
(roletype object_r hal_drm_widevine_exec)
(typeattributeset domain (hal_drm_widevine))
(typeattributeset halserverdomain (hal_drm_widevine))
(typeattributeset halclientdomain (hal_drm_widevine))
(typeattributeset hal_drm (hal_drm_widevine))
(typeattributeset hal_drm_server (hal_drm_widevine))
(typeattributeset hal_allocator_client (hal_drm_widevine))
(typeattributeset file_type (hal_drm_widevine_exec))
(typeattributeset exec_type (hal_drm_widevine_exec))
(typeattributeset vendor_file_type (hal_drm_widevine_exec))

;; ---- 启动链：rc 不带 seclabel，靠 APEX 内文件标签换域 ----
(allow init_{{vers}} hal_drm_widevine_exec (file (read getattr map execute open)))
(allow init_{{vers}} hal_drm_widevine (process (transition siginh rlimitinh)))
(dontaudit init_{{vers}} hal_drm_widevine (process (noatsecure)))
(typetransition init_{{vers}} hal_drm_widevine_exec process hal_drm_widevine)
(allow hal_drm_widevine hal_drm_widevine_exec (file (read getattr map execute open entrypoint)))

;; ---- APEX 内库只读映射 ----
(allow hal_drm_widevine vendor_file_{{vers}} (file (read getattr map open)))

;; ---- vndbinder 与 servicemanager 注册 ----
(allow hal_drm_widevine vndbinder_device_{{vers}} (chr_file (ioctl read write getattr lock append map open watch watch_reads)))
(allow hal_drm_widevine vndservicemanager_{{vers}} (binder (call transfer)))
(allow vndservicemanager_{{vers}} hal_drm_widevine (dir (search)))
(allow vndservicemanager_{{vers}} hal_drm_widevine (file (read map open)))
(allow vndservicemanager_{{vers}} hal_drm_widevine (process (getattr)))

(allow hal_drm_widevine mediaserver_service_{{vers}} (service_manager (add find)))
(allow hal_drm_widevine default_android_service_{{vers}} (service_manager (add find)))
(allow hal_drm_widevine pioneer (binder (call transfer)))
(allow pioneer hal_drm_widevine (binder (call transfer)))

(allow hal_drm_widevine base_typeattr_232_{{vers}} (fd (use)))

(allow hal_drm_widevine vendor_data_file_{{vers}} (file (ioctl read write create getattr setattr lock append map unlink rename open watch watch_reads)))
